name: Package Managers
description: Protects against dangerous package manager operations like publishing \ packages and removing critical system packages

destructive_patterns.name: npm-publish
destructive_patterns.description: npm publish releases a package publicly. Use --dry-run first.

destructive_patterns.name: yarn-publish
destructive_patterns.description: yarn publish releases a package publicly. Verify package.json first.

destructive_patterns.name: pnpm-publish
destructive_patterns.description: pnpm publish releases a package publicly.

destructive_patterns.name: npm-unpublish
destructive_patterns.description: npm unpublish removes a published package. This can break dependent projects.

destructive_patterns.name: pip-uninstall
destructive_patterns.description: pip uninstall removes installed packages. Verify dependencies before removing.

destructive_patterns.name: pip-url
destructive_patterns.description: pip install from URL can install unvetted code. Verify the source first.

destructive_patterns.name: pip-system
destructive_patterns.description: pip install to system directories requires careful review.

destructive_patterns.name: apt-remove
destructive_patterns.description: apt remove/purge removes packages. Verify no critical packages are affected.

destructive_patterns.name: yum-remove
destructive_patterns.description: yum/dnf remove removes packages. Verify no critical packages are affected.

destructive_patterns.name: cargo-publish
destructive_patterns.description: cargo publish releases a crate to crates.io. Use --dry-run first.

destructive_patterns.name: cargo-yank
destructive_patterns.description: cargo yank marks a version as unavailable. This can break dependent projects.

destructive_patterns.name: gem-push
destructive_patterns.description: gem push releases a gem to rubygems.org. Verify before publishing.

destructive_patterns.name: brew-uninstall
destructive_patterns.description: brew uninstall removes packages. Verify no dependent packages are affected.

destructive_patterns.name: poetry-publish
destructive_patterns.description: poetry publish releases a package. Use --dry-run first.

destructive_patterns.name: poetry-remove
destructive_patterns.description: poetry remove uninstalls a dependency. Verify no critical packages are affected.

destructive_patterns.name: maven-deploy
destructive_patterns.description: mvn deploy publishes artifacts to a remote repository. Verify target repository.

destructive_patterns.name: maven-release-perform
destructive_patterns.description: mvn release:perform publishes a release. Verify version and repository.

destructive_patterns.name: gradle-publish
destructive_patterns.description: gradle publish uploads artifacts. Use --dry-run first when possible.
